product_one_liner.value: TrackTik is a security workforce-management platform that helps security companies and enterprise security teams manage guard operations, from incident reporting through back-office workflows.

pricing_page.notes: The page offers custom-quote pricing; public list prices are not required for this answer.

employee_band.notes: PitchBook separately reports 465 employees, consistent with this band.

eng_blog.notes: The public blog is a security-operations/content blog; no qualifying engineering-authored posts describing how the product is built were identified.

public_docs.notes: The public TrackTik Help Center has multiple product articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers page lists sales roles, with no AI, ML, or data-science role title.

model_provider.notes: Public ReportPro AI materials and the reviewed trust/privacy and subprocessor materials describe generative AI and data handling but do not identify a model or model provider.

compliance_certs.notes: The trust page also names ISO 27017 and NIST, which are outside the requested list.

last_funding.notes: CB Insights lists a July 27, 2023 Series B of $0.37M as the latest round; other profiles emphasize the older 2019 K1 growth-equity investment, so confidence is medium.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest dated round listed is July 2023, before the 18-month window beginning May 9, 2025.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A live Account Executive posting is listed.

launched_6mo.notes: August 2026 release notes introduce multiple Tour Routes features, including missed-tour detection/alerts and interval-based recurrence scheduling.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Scott Kaine was appointed CEO on January 12, 2026, within the 12 months before November 9, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: These systems are named in the Salesforce Systems Administrator posting as existing integrations/GTM or marketing tools.
